subject.title: improve(telegram): align QA coverage with startup behavior

question: May the `telegram.startup-getme` taxonomy target be considered adequately covered by deterministic product-startup tests when the dedicated live Gateway scenario reports blocked because no leased Telegram credential is available?
rationale: This is a release-coverage policy choice rather than a mechanical code defect: the branch avoids a false pass, but only maintainers can set the acceptable relationship between deterministic and live evidence for this target.

options.title: Require positive live startup evidence
options.body: Keep the PR open until a redacted leased-credential run shows the real Gateway `getMe` path reaching polling successfully.

options.title: Accept deterministic coverage with a blocked live lane
options.body: Merge with the blocked result retained and document that this taxonomy target is deterministic-only until credential-backed evidence can be collected.

recommendation.title: Require positive live startup evidence
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until a redacted leased-credential run shows the real Gateway `getMe` path reaching polling successfully.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current Telegram QA proposal and related evidence design, though the final proof policy remains a broader maintainer decision.
